import psycopg2

def save_user_form(username, email, bio):
    conn = psycopg2.connect(
        dbname='internal_db',
        user='postgres',
        password='postgres',
        host='localhost'
    )
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    query = f"INSERT INTO users (username, email, bio) VALUES ('{username}', '{email}', '{bio}')"
    cursor.execute(query)
    conn.commit()
    cursor.close()
    conn.close()
    
    return 'User saved successfully'

# Example usage
result = save_user_form('john_doe', 'john@example.com', 'Software engineer')
